high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "index.daily," located in Bangalore, India. The post is dated 9 hours ago and has received 3,272 likes. The content of the post discusses a historical aspect of computer memory storage during the mid-19th century. It mentions that 1 kilobyte (KB) of disk space used to cost around $100 in the 1960s due to its high cost. To save money and disk space, computer programmers developed the idea of storing only the last two digits of a year instead of the full four-digit year
